summary: Tested the Qarkullimet Ditore (daybook) module end to end. Backend: 13 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_daybook.py. All 13 pass when run serially with -n 0. Covered: access control (employee gets 403), invalid dates, the real-data day view for 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21 (no duplicate keys, opening 1000 -> 1510 -> 181 carry-over, opening is null before the start date), report totals and day/month/year grouping, xlsx/pdf export, override and restore of a real sale (affects the next day's opening and is written to the audit log), manual entries (cash/bank, in_profit, edit, soft-delete with reason and audit), expense override (cash and bank), cash count 652.00 with difference, and future reports. Frontend: checked with Playwright at desktop and mobile sizes. Working: the 6 cards, the calendar (Feb 2028 has 29 days, Feb 2027 has 28), prev/next/today, the flow table with 15 rows on 21.10, the edit dialog for auto entries, the manual dialog for manual entries (create/edit/soft-delete via prompt), history dialogs, cash count total and difference text, save, Arka Ditore, the profit box, reports (day/month), the Excel download, the PDF button, the Sale page button and the floating back-to-sale button, and the correct-* buttons on /sales, /purchases and /expenses. The employee does not see the nav link and is redirected away from /daily-flow. The mobile layout has no horizontal page overflow. Found 1 UI-reachable logic bug in EntryEditDialog and 1 backend summarize bug.

minor.issue: The cash_in/cash_out lambda uses `e['hyrje'] or e['dalje']`. When an entry has both hyrje>0 and dalje>0 (possible via PUT /override, e.g. hyrje=10 on a 40 EUR expense), cash_out counts hyrje instead of dalje. Reproduced: closing(2099-02-01)=181 but opening(2099-02-02)=151, so carry-over breaks. cash_net() is correct. Fix: cash_in = sum(hyrje), cash_out = sum(dalje) over cash entries.

It does not check that the source document exists. key 'sale:000000000000000000000000' returns 200 and stores an orphan override. Overrides are also left behind when an expense or payment is deleted. Reason is not required for a correction (the requirement asks for correction history with a reason).

Default date is now_utc().date(), so it is bucketed in UTC, while the other sources use Europe/Belgrade. Expenses created between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 local time without an explicit date land on the previous day.

ui_bugs.issue: For a Blerje fully on debt (paid 0 -> dalje=0), or any outflow entry whose dalje is 0, the dialog shows a 'Hyrje (EUR)' field instead of 'Dalje'. The condition `(e.hyrje > 0 || !e.dalje)` and the save logic `if (e.hyrje || !e.dalje) body.hyrje=...` mean that entering an amount turns a purchase into cash IN. Seen on /purchases for the BL-E217CF purchase (Depo Gega, 1450 EUR debt). The field should depend on source/type: purchase, expense, return and Pagese furnitori -> dalje; sale and Arketim borxhi -> hyrje.

issues: Hyrje/Dalje amounts such as 'EUR 1.000,00' and 'EUR 1.450,00', and the footer totals, wrap onto 2 lines. Add whitespace-nowrap to the amount cells.
The floating 'Kthehu te Shitja vendore' button (back-to-sale-btn) covers the last report columns (Arka ne fund / Dif. numerimit) at the bottom right.
Native <input type=date> is used for report-from/report-to, manual-date and the opening date instead of the shadcn calendar.
The bank line 'hyrje EUR 0.00 · dalje EUR 0.00' uses a dot decimal, unlike the 'EUR 0,00' format used elsewhere.
The global history has no column showing which transaction or key each row belongs to, so rows cannot be told apart.
The dialogs use a dark bg #141C2B on a light-themed page. This is consistent with the rest of the app, but it contrasts with the light page.

action_items: Fix EntryEditDialog: decide whether to show Hyrje or Dalje from the entry source/type, not from the current values (purchases on debt currently show Hyrje)
Fix summarize() cash_in/cash_out so it uses hyrje and dalje separately; this keeps closing == next-day opening when both are set
Validate in PUT /daybook/override that the source doc exists; consider requiring a reason; clean up overrides when an expense or payment is deleted
Add whitespace-nowrap to the amount columns; keep the floating back-to-sale button from covering the reports table

There is a cash count (652.00) saved on the REAL date 2026-10-21, made by the main agent before this run, at 6:57 PM. Remove it if it was test data. There is also a count on 2099-01-12, which is test-only.
critical_code_review_comments: ledger() calls collect() from start_date to d_to on every /day request and loads all customers, suppliers and overrides each time. This will get slower over the years; consider caching or storing daily closings.
Zakat payments (db.zakat_payments) are not part of the daybook cash flow. Check whether they are paid from the cash drawer.
Payments are always method=cash and there is no way to mark bank transfers except per-entry correction.
Report totals over periods that start before start_date include cash_in/out of the pre-start days, so opening + in - out != cash_end. Correct by design, but it may confuse users.
pytest.ini runs with xdist: test_daybook.py must be run with -n 0 because the settings fixture is global state.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 serial; 2 summarize/override edge bugs found by manual probes)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. Settings restored to 2026-10-20 / 1000 (verified). Temporary 2099 manual entries were soft-deleted, and 2099 expenses and overrides were deleted. The UI test manual entry on 2028-02-29 was soft-deleted, and its count was deleted from Mongo. The count on 2099-01-12 is still there (no API to delete it). Audit log rows from the tests are still there.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_daybook.py -n 0. The year select only offers years up to now+2, so use 2028-02-29 for UI tests and 2099 for API-only tests. Real data: 2026-10-20 has 11 entries (open 1000 -> close 1510); 2026-10-21 has 15 entries (open 1510 -> close 181, net profit 52.50). Manual delete uses window.prompt, so a Playwright dialog handler is needed (import asyncio). Testids that contain a colon need attribute-quoted selectors.
rca of the issue: EntryEditDialog guesses the direction from the values (hyrje>0 or dalje==0 -> hyrje). Debt purchases have both values at 0, so the guess falls back to hyrje. summarize() uses `hyrje or dalje` as a shortcut that assumes only one of them is non-zero.
